summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Bulk Import Students (CSV) feature on /app/students as institution_admin (admin@greenwood.edu). Verified all 4 dialog phases (context -> upload -> preview -> result), cascading EnrollmentPicker, CSV parse (incl. quoted fields with commas), client-side validation (missing first_name, in-file duplicate admission_no), DB-duplicate skip surfaced by backend, list refresh after Done, plus edge cases (header-only CSV, all-invalid CSV, dialog state reset on reopen) and regressions (search, Enroll Student wizard, enroll-existing dialog, edit save, delete, not-enrolled banner, Class Hub Enrollments tab). All core assertions passed; only cosmetic/UX issues found. Test data fully cleaned up - Greenwood is back to exactly 1 student (Aarav Shah, GW001) with 1 enrollment and no orphan enrollment rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Skipped-row numbers come from the backend payload index (only valid rows are sent), so they do not map to CSV file rows. GW001 was file row 5 but the result showed 'Row 3: Duplicate admission no GW001'. Misleading for large files.

Result summary only counts backend skips. Client-side skipped rows (missing first name / in-file duplicate) are dropped from the payload and never reported again, so a 5-row file with 3 actual skips displayed '2 students enrolled ... 1 skipped'. Users lose the record of what was dropped once the preview closes.
Pluralization bug: single created row renders '1 students enrolled into Grade 6'.
No CSV row-number column and no per-row data-testid, making it hard for a user (or test) to locate the offending line in a large file.
Form inputs have no name= or data-testid attributes; only positional selectors work. Testability gap.

issues: Date of birth uses the native browser date input/picker instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere
Dropzone shows the placeholder filename 'students_template.csv' even before any file is chosen, which reads as if a file is already selected

action_items: Report client-side skips in the result step too (merge preview errors with backend skipped list) and map skipped row numbers back to CSV line numbers
Fix '1 students enrolled' pluralization in the result step
Optional: add a row-number column + per-row data-testid to the preview table; add name/data-testid to FormDialog inputs
critical_code_review_comments: BulkImportDialog.doImport sends only valid rows, so backend `row` indexes are relative to the filtered array - keep the original CSV index on each row and map it back before rendering result.skipped.

onFile does not clear previously parsed rows when a new file fails validation (e.g. header-only file after a good file) - stale `rows` remain in state; harmless today because phase stays on upload, but fragile.
Backend bulk-enroll inserts row-by-row (N round-trips); consider insert_many/bulk_write for large CSVs.
Backend bulk-enroll has no cap on payload size - a huge CSV could be a DoS/timeout vector; add a max-rows validation.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request; endpoint exercised indirectly via UI - all calls 200/expected)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of required flows passed (5 cosmetic/UX issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TESTQA1/TESTQA2/TESTQA6 students via bulk import for verification; ALL deleted at end. Greenwood left with exactly 1 student (Aarav Shah GW001) and 1 enrollment - verified via Students list and Class Hub > Enrollments (no orphan enrollments; class card back to '1 sec · 1 std').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk import UI verified end-to-end: context step gates Continue on class (year/unit/class/section cascade correct: only unit General, class Grade 6, section A, year 2026-27); header-only CSV -> toast 'CSV has no data rows' and stays on upload; all-invalid CSV -> 'Import 0 students' disabled; quoted CSV fields parsed correctly ('Roy, Jr'); preview showed 3 ready / 2 skipped with 'Missing first name' and 'Duplicate admission no in file'; confirm -> result '2 students enrolled ... 1 skipped (GW001 DB duplicate)'; Done closed dialog and list refreshed with Enrolled badges + Grade 6/A. Note DataTable row-action testids are suffixed with row id (e.g. enroll-student-btn-<id>, edit-btn-<id>, delete-btn-<id>) - use prefix selectors. Class Hub tabs are not role=tab; click by text.
rca_of_the_issue: Row-number mismatch in the result step: BulkImportDialog filters out invalid rows before POST, so the backend enumerates the filtered list and returns 1-based indexes of that shortened array, which the UI renders verbatim as 'Row N'.
